title: The Day a Change of Declared Particulars Takes Effect
content:
The day a change of declared particulars takes effect on a certificate of the Travel Protection Plans is
read from the policy service requests the underwriting desk holds against that policy, together with whether the
journey has begun.

## The three readings

1. Where the underwriting desk has recorded an approved request against the policy and the journey has not
   begun, the day the change takes effect is the day the desk approved it.
2. Where such a request stands and the journey has begun, the day the change takes effect is the day the request
   was submitted.
3. In every other case the day the change takes effect is the day the certificate was issued.

Where more than one approved request stands against the policy, the day taken is the one carried by the request
submitted last.

## Points of judgement

A request submitted on the 2nd and approved on the 5th, on a journey whose first date is the 20th, takes effect
on the 5th under the first reading. The same request on a journey whose first date was the 1st takes effect on
the 2nd under the second reading, the journey having begun. Where no approved request stands against the policy
at all, the third reading answers and the day the change takes effect is the day the certificate was issued,
whether or not the journey has begun. The dates are hypothetical.
